g.text: Detector, bias tee, and RF readout
Shared circuit for both operating regimes · Default c30 configuration
SNSPD shape follows the installed snspdWithPhotonPort symbol.
The photon arrow denotes model excitation; it is not a wire.
The meander is a symbol, not a scale drawing of the device.
Pin names follow the current model's subcircuit order.
